text:
Alex: heads-up, handing the bridge to @Maria in ~10. quick pre-handoff checklist so the night anchor doesn't get surprised.

Alex: PagerDuty—I am primary until 00:00 UTC, Maria you become primary then. can you confirm you see the primary badge in PD? (search: 'redwood-prod-primary')

Maria: I can see myself in the PD schedule but not the primary badge for the prod escalation policy (maybe caching). will refresh and confirm.

Alex: cool. also verify AWS console role and Grafana. AWS: need assume-role access to arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OncallTempRole (JIT). Grafana: team read+annotate, and dashboard edit for the runbook pins.

Tariq: quick note—there's a coverage gap 02:30-04:00 UTC tomorrow morning due to APAC PTO. if the bridge stays up past 02:10 we might not have a secondary in region. can someone take the swing shift or set an escalation fallback?

Maria: I can pick up 02:30-03:30 if it helps. otherwise we should add the regional fallback (escalate to SRE rotation).

Alex: thanks. for fallback, set PD policy: primary -> secondary -> region-fallback. Jane, can you confirm region-fallback has a live contact?

Jane: region-fallback is tech-ops-asia. it's on-call but limited. I'd rather have a named person if we expect mitigation work. Maria taking 02:30-03:30 is ideal.

Alex: incident bot ping:
IncidentBot: Incident 2026-03-15T23:45Z created — PROD latency spike on inference-serving. Pages sent to Alex (primary) and Maria (secondary). See: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2043

Maria: got the incident link, loading dashboards. Grafana access is OK for me (read + annotate). one thing: I don't have temp admin to mute noisy alerts, only annotate.

Alex: good catch—muting requires grafana:team-admin role. we avoid muting unless we have clear suppression plan. but for noise control we can add a silence in PagerDuty (preferred).

Tariq: adding the commands we'll need if we escalate to a full mitigation run:
# assume role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OncallTempRole --role-session-name oncall-session
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...
# grafana: open dashboard and annotate
open https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/serve/latency?orgId=1

Alex: also runbook pointers (please bookmark):
- Live mitigation runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/mitigations/latency-spike
- PD escalation policy doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/PagerDuty+Escalations
- JIT role request form: https://okta.redwood.ai/app/UserHome

Tariq: if anyone needs temporary Grafana admin we use the JIT ticket process (Okta -> request OncallTempGrafana role). approvals go to infra-leads. expect ~10-20min turnaround during business hours.

Maria: confirmed PD primary badge visible now. I can take the handoff at 00:00 UTC. I've submitted a JIT request for OncallTempRole just in case.

Alex: perfect. last checklist:
- PD: primary switch at 00:00 (Maria) :thumbsup:
- AWS: JIT request submitted (Maria)
- Grafana: read+annotate OK, admin JIT in flight
- Region gap covered by Maria 02:30-03:30

Alex: tagging runbook steps for the night anchor: 1) confirm PD primary, 2) verify Grafana and Datadog dashboards load, 3) verify ability to create a PD silence, 4) ensure KMS access for key-rewrap is present (ops-svcs team).

OpsBot: Reminder — please follow the on-call handoff checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Oncall+Handoff+Checklist (automated DM will be sent to new primary).

Maria: handoff complete from my side — I'm primary as of 00:00 UTC. Alex, leaving the bridge to you for a few min to finalize notes?

Alex: leaving bridge. noted: incident still watched, scaling rules triggered but auto-heal hasn't completed. Maria, escalate to SRE if we need deeper infra changes. thanks everyone. :wave:
